title: Enterprise clauses contextualizer and auto-suggest for SSQ routing
creator: Aisha Ramirez
description: Build a contextual clause suggestion engine and SSQ-aware routing rules that surface pre-approved redlines, pricing flags, and an automated escalation recommendation to Legal/Sales Ops. The goal is to reduce manual triage time on MSA/DPA redlines and speed up negotiations for mid-market customers while ensuring high-risk clauses are routed to the right reviewers with annotated reason codes.
background: We frequently see long latency on contract turnaround for customers with custom SSQ responses. Current triage is manual: Sales uploads the SSQ, Legal inspects, then requests redlines. This adds 3-6 weeks to deals. There are existing playbooks but they are text-heavy and require deep legal knowledge. We want to encode contextual rules (customer tier, SSQ risk flags, indemnity thresholds, data sovereignty needs) to propose deterministic routing and a best-effort clause suggestion that Legal can approve in bulk.
proposed_solution: Phase 1: Clause contextualizer microservice that consumes SSQ outputs and contract template, scores risk (low/medium/high) per clause, and produces 3 auto-suggest actions: Accept, Soft-Redline (pre-approved concession), Escalate. Integrations: Redwood Console (contract UI), Sales CRM metadata, Legal queue (Jira/Linear). Phase 2: Pricing flagger ties indemnity/liability concessions to pricing delta recommendations for Sales to accept or negotiate.
acceptance_criteria: 1) The contextualizer correctly classifies sample SSQs into risk bands with >85% agreement with Legal on a 50-sample validation set. 2) Console shows inline suggested action per clause and 'reason' tooltip. 3) Suggested routing sends high-risk items to Legal within SLA and auto-approves soft redlines without human intervention when preconditions met. 4) Sales sees pricing delta suggestions when indemnity/liability concessions exceed thresholds.
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Build model schema, legal rule catalog, and minimal API. Week 3: QA with Legal on 50 anonymized SSQs. Week 4: Console integration behind feature flag and pilot with 2 sales pods. Week 6: Iterate on precision and expand to all mid-market deals. Communication: Legal training session + quick reference card; Sales enablement doc and one-pager.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-automation could approve risky concessions. Mitigation: conservative default rules; require human signoff for high-risk. Risk: Security/SSQ PII leakage to service. Mitigation: data redaction, VPC-only access, and separate logs. Risk: Legal resistance. Mitigation: co-design sessions and opt-in pilot with Legal SMEs.
notes: Legal asked for clause-level audit log and 'why' explanation for each suggestion. Design requested tooltip copy and small visual affordances to reduce accidental approvals. Pricing suggested a simple indemnity slider mapping to draft pricing delta to keep Sales accountable.
